content: Disaster recovery for Azure Functions durable task scheduler is now available in public preview for the Dedicated SKU in supported Azure regions. Recover business-critical workflows from regional outages without rebuilding orchestration state, with a repeatable path to resume processing in another region. Customers can pair a primary scheduler with a passive secondary scheduler in another region. Durable task scheduler replicates orchestration state to the paired scheduler and provides a customer-initiated planned failover operation, reducing the custom recovery engineering required for regulated and mission-critical workloads. The preview uses an active-passive model. Customers remain responsible for deploying compatible workers, compute, networking, and application dependencies in the secondary region, redirecting application traffic, and initiating scheduler failover through their disaster recovery runbook. Processing resumes from durable checkpoints, and in-progress work might replay or re-execute after failover. Learn more.
